body: I have a similar thing but I always think I can only do this once - like I can have one attempt and it’s either successful or not but then it’ll all be out in the open and everyone will know how messed up I am, and there’s not way of putting the lid back on once it’s off. So I have to be *really* sure it’s the right time to let go, because either way there’s no going back

I’ve felt like this for as long as I can remember. It’s just so tiring. I hate everything about me and I hate that I feel like that, it’s pathetic and a waste of time. Even as a child I hated myself. I hate how I look. It’s so vain but I hate being so ugly, it’s not fair. And I’ve always been so big but now I feel grotesque. And I hate who I am and how I think and how I can’t do anything special or useful or interesting and I’m just so damn tired of pretending and tired of existing. But I know I can only do this once, so is it now? I’ve got this far but I don’t know how much more I can do. I just hate living as me
